Key Responsibilities Lead and develop the IT Service Desk team across multiple locations Ensure consistent, timely, and customer-focused IT support services Drive continual improvement of service delivery processes and tools Manage incident, problem, change, and service management practices Oversee service desk performance, ticket management, and escalations Coordinate responses to significant incidents and service outages Manage desktop, laptop, mobile device, and application lifecycle processes Maintain technology asset management and CMDB practices Develop service documentation, knowledge resources, and user communications Work closely with stakeholders across the business to understand needs and improve service outcomes Support after-hours support processes for critical business issues Manage relevant operational and capital budgets About You You're a collaborative and customer-focused leader who understands that great technology services are about enabling people to do their best work. You can balance operational priorities with long-term improvement opportunities and are comfortable building strong relationships across a diverse and complex organisation. You Will Bring 5+ years' experience in IT service delivery, service desk leadership, or a similar management role Experience leading and developing geographically dispersed teams Strong understanding of IT service management principles and frameworks, including ITIL Experience managing incident, problem, and change management processes Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills Strong analytical and problem-solving capability Understanding of cybersecurity and technology risk management best practices Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment A tertiary qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline Ideally You'll Also Have ITIL certification or equivalent industry certification Experience supporting large multi-site organisations Experience with service desk platforms and IT asset management practices Knowledge of continuous improvement methodologies and service performance reporting Please note that we are only considering candidates who are currently eligible to work in New Zealand. About Us At Alliance Group, we're more than a global supplier of exceptional grass-fed lamb, beef, and venison. We're a purpose-driven business committed to driving prosperity for our farming families and creating thriving environments for our people. With sites across the North and South Islands, we're focused on performance improvement, innovation, and improving our environmental resilience. What We Offer Health insurance subsidies for you and your family One week's additional annual leave Ongoing professional development and training opportunities Career development within a large New Zealand business Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) A supportive and collaborative team environment The opportunity to make a significant impact across a nationwide organisation Flexible and engaging work with a combination of operational leadership and strategic improvement initiatives Alliance Group is committed to creating a workplace where everyone is treated with fairness, dignity and respect. We recruit, develop and promote people based on their skills, experience, qualifications and potential. We are committed to providing an inclusive, safe and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to succeed and feel valued. If you require any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, please let us know. We are happy to work with you to ensure you can participate fully. Applications close on 20 December 2026. Applications will be reviewed from the week commencing 18 January 2027, with shortlisting to follow.

operate the service confidently Support operational readiness for new features, regions and cloud providers, including testing failure scenarios before launch Work with engineering, support and Programar as férias de todos os colaboradores de acordo com as condições repassadas pelo Departamento de Gestão de Pessoas, organizando-as de forma que não haja impactos negativos na operação e/ou no quadro de colaborares do Ponto de Apoio; Efetuar vistorias nos veículos, através de inspeções e preenchimento de check list, para avaliar as condições do veículo e emitir quando necessário, uma OS ao setor de Manutenção, para a realização dos reparos necessários, contribuindo para que todos os veículos da frota se mantenham em condições de trabalho evitando imprevistos que possam prejudicar a operação ou integridade do motorista; Posicionar o gestor do próximo turno os acontecimentos relevantes na operação ou informações para os próximos dias de trabalho; Emitir, através do sistema, os CTE´s, para fins de cobrança dos clientes; Atender a solicitações de coletas de clientes, recebidas por e-mail ou ligações telefônicas, inteirando-se dos detalhes, junto ao sistema, a fim de transmiti-las, por meio da emissão de uma ordem de coleta, ao motorista mais próximo da região onde realizará a coleta; Efetuar a emissão das viagens, com base em dados recebidos da Operação, para as cargas sejam expedidas devidamente manifestadas; Gerar relatórios, planilhas, listas e outros, para fins de diversos controles, posicionamento do andamento das entregas aos clientes, informação a expedição, através dos dados dos CTE´s para fins de cobrança do cliente e pagamento aos motoristas (Contrato de frete); Efetuar o cadastro de motoristas, veículos, fornecedores e proprietários, analisando previamente os documentos, consultando sites internos e externos, a fim de efetuar a inserção dos dados, para que os motoristas e veículos estejam aptos para o trabalho; Efetuar o agendamento de coletas, recepcionando as solicitações, contatando o fornecedor para a transmissão dos detalhes da carga, visando a capacitação máxima dos veículos da empresa; Manter controle sobre as coletas e entregas, através de follow-up junto aos respectivos motoristas, contribuindo para assegurar a qualidade na realização dos serviços prestados pela empresa; review_candidates.title: Senior Assistant Company Secretary | ASX-Listed Governance | Funds Management & Corporate Secretariat
review_candidates.description: Board and committee exposure | ASX and ASIC compliance | Managed funds governance Greenfields Executive Recruitment & Search is partnering with an ASX-listed funds management group for a Senior Assistant Company Secretary to support its listed entities, managed funds and Board committees. Reporting to the General Counsel & Joint Company Secretary, you will take responsibility for the day-to-day work that keeps a complex governance calendar running, while contributing to disclosure, reporting and governance improvement. The remit offers direct contact with directors and senior executives. It calls for someone equally comfortable drafting minutes and advising on governance processes, coordinating a Board meeting and checking that statutory records and lodgements are complete. The role Listed entity governance: Support ASX Listing Rule compliance, continuous disclosure and ASX Online lodgements. Contribute to annual reporting, governance disclosures, directors’ interests and securities trading records. Securityholder meetings: Lead the planning and delivery of annual and extraordinary general meetings, coordinating advisers, registry providers and internal stakeholders. Draft meeting notices, scripts, presentations and Chair briefing materials. Board and committee cycle: Own calendars, workplans, agendas, paper commissioning, meeting logistics and secure records for allocated Boards and committees. Attend meetings and prepare accurate minutes, resolutions and action records. Director and executive support: Manage meeting diaries, travel and Board events; support director appointments and inductions; and oversee relevant service providers, invoices and payments. Governance frameworks: Maintain charters, policies, delegations and precedents. Guide the preparation and timely submission of Board papers, and improve the systems, templates and processes used by the secretariat. Entities and lodgements: Maintain statutory registers and corporate records, manage ASIC lodgements and annual reviews, and coordinate entity and fund changes. Work closely with the colleague supporting managed funds, maintaining appropriate separation between listed group and fund decisions. About you You have at least five years’ company secretariat and governance experience supporting an ASX-listed entity. Your experience includes Board and committee administration, minutes and resolutions, ASX and ASIC lodgements, continuous disclosure, annual reporting and securityholder meetings. You know the ASX Listing Rules and Corporate Governance Principles and Recommendations, and can work autonomously across the full Board cycle. A Graduate Diploma of Applied Corporate Governance or an equivalent recognised governance qualification is required. You have completed the ASX Listing Rules Compliance Course or are willing to do so promptly after appointment. Experience with Diligent Boards and Diligent Entities, or comparable platforms, together with ASX Online, ASIC portals and Microsoft 365, is relevant to the role. You bring sound judgement, precise drafting and the confidence to work with directors, executives and advisers. Experience in real estate investment, funds management, financial services or another regulated environment is highly regarded but not essential. A tertiary qualification in law, business, commerce or a related field is also highly regarded. About Greenfields Executive Recruitment & Search Greenfields is one of Sydney's most highly valued, top ranked executive search firms in legal, governance, risk, compliance and company secretarial appointments. We are frequently retained by ASX-listed companies, private and family-owned groups, not-for-profits and government to appoint Chief Legal Officers, General Counsel, General Counsel & Company Secretary, Heads of Legal, Heads of Legal, Governance, Risk and Compliance, Head of Governance and Company Secretary, Heads of Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC), and highly technical senior in-house counsel. Interested? This search is being led by Catherine Wolfe-Coote, Founder & Managing Director of Greenfields Executive Recruitment & Search. Apply in confidence, or contact Catherine directly for a discreet conversation about the role. Catherine Wolfe-Coote Founder & Managing Director Greenfields Executive Recruitment & Search catherinew@greenfieldssearch.com.au
